objective: Continue the full Oyatie mockup toward Bominal-grade completeness by upgrading the identity, workforce, auth, roles, employees, onboarding, and evidence routes from a sparse settings panel into a dense cohesive command center.

gap_analysis.source: live dashboard gap scan after the Daily Execution polish
findings_addressed: The default Identity/Workforce Auth panel had a large blank lower area after the passkey and security score controls.
Identity, role, employee, onboarding, workflow, mail, finance, and evidence concepts existed but did not read as one cohesive product operation in the default view.
The surface needed Bominal-style dense lineage, risk queue, lifecycle state, and cross-suite route actions rather than a settings-only feel.
Interactions needed to remain visually functional and local-only: no real SSO, HRIS, directory, payroll, or evidence writes.

implemented: Added an Identity Command Center board under the Auth panel so the default identity view fills with operational density rather than blank space.
Added an Access Spine that links Passkey, Session, Role, Employee, Workflow, and Audit as one governed identity path from authentication to payroll close.
Added an Identity Risk Queue for payroll approver recertification, vendor guest PII denial, and passkey challenge evidence.
Added Workforce Lifecycle bars for onboarding, role review, session hygiene, and payroll readiness.
Added a Route Matrix from Identity to Workflow Studio, Mail reviewer, Session audit, Onboarding, Payroll close, and Evidence Spine.
Mirrored the command board in the SSR static identity suite so it is present before hydration.
Extended fallback JavaScript with data-identity-route-action handling for route buttons, local status updates, active route state, and activity-center events.
Added flat, low-radius, dense CSS matching the Bominal tactical design language: bordered grid lineage, compact risk rows, lifecycle bars, and route buttons.

observations: live server reachable on 127.0.0.1:3000 after 4 seconds

verification.command: Playwright smoke for #identity-workforce-suite, command board density, passkey staging, employee search, session route, Mail route, Evidence route, console/network health
pixelmatch secondary debug diffs against Bominal corporate, employees, and workflow-studio references cropped to shared viewport

observations.method: pixelmatch threshold=0.12, anti-alias ignored; secondary structural evidence only

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style identity/workforce command center integrated with auth, roles, employees, onboarding, workflow, mail, finance, and evidence surfaces
visual_verdict.verdict: The default Identity/Workforce surface now reads as a dense operational product surface rather than a sparse settings panel. The new access spine, risk queue, lifecycle bars, and route matrix connect identity decisions to payroll close, Workflow Studio, Mail, and Evidence Spine while preserving local-only visual behavior.
improved_matches: The former blank lower area is replaced by dense, high-signal operational content.
Identity is no longer isolated from the rest of Oyatie; the command board shows concrete routes to Workflow, Mail, Finance, Employee Directory, Onboarding, Sessions, and Evidence.
The visual language now uses compact bordered grids, tactical lineage cells, low-radius buttons, and spreadsheet-like progress bars consistent with Bominal references.
SSR and fallback/hydrated interactions both expose the new command surface.
remaining_differences: No real authentication mutation, SSO action, HRIS write, payroll change, or audit-chain write is wired.
This advances the complete mockup; a final cross-surface completion audit is still required before claiming the whole dashboard is finished.

non_claims: No passkey is registered with a real identity provider.
No employee, role, session, payroll, mail, workflow, or evidence backend is mutated.
All interactions are visual-only local prototype state.
This is one additional polish slice toward the full mockup, not a claim that the entire dashboard is complete.
